neighbours.label: a semicolon closing a definition of an abstract concept (Entropy measures ...; it is not ...)
fire: Justice, in this account, is a relation among citizens rather than a private virtue; it is not a feeling.
Gravity is a curvature of spacetime produced by mass and energy; it is not a force in the usual sense.
Knowledge is commonly defined as a justified belief that happens to be true; opinion falls short of this.
Inflation refers to a general rise in the price level across an economy; it is not a rise in any one price.
A metaphor is a figure of speech that describes one thing in terms of another; it asserts no literal identity.
Culture consists of the learned habits and symbols shared within a group; it is not inherited through genes.
Sovereignty denotes the supreme authority of a state within its own territory; there is no higher power there.
Memory is an active reconstruction of past events from stored fragments; it is not a recording.
quiet: Philosophers have argued about justice among citizens for many centuries; few of them agree.
Physicists have measured gravity near the poles and the equator for many decades; the numbers vary slightly.
Knowledge of Latin spread slowly through the monastery schools of northern France; few monks could read.
Bread at the corner shop cost two dollars more on Tuesday than on Monday; my aunt did not buy any.
The poet used one striking metaphor in the opening lines of her last book; nobody asked why.
The villagers danced around the fire and shared a meal after the long harvest; it did not rain.
Sovereignty over the island passed to Spain after a short and costly war; there was no treaty.
Grandma put the old photographs back into the box under her bed last night; it was not heavy.

notes: Third look at this pole, narrowed after sweep 11's first round (median 0.196). Probes put the comma forms lower than the semicolon forms, so this test is semicolons only and says nothing about commas. Five near misses keep the abstract topic without defining it; three are concrete narrative.
